comment: Signal jacks 2 to 16 share one line with jack 1 because the code treats them identically (append.cpp:84). With no signal patched, Width is read through a different expression (append.cpp:93) that rescales 0-10V onto 1..17 before clamping, so the top of the range is reached slightly early.
